result_text:
`cargo check -p shep-channel` passes. A line of invalid UTF-8 now comes back as `ChannelError::Malformed`, and the next `read_message` call returns the frame on the following line.

The change is in `crates/shep-channel/src/session.rs:15-26`:
- `read_message` now reads the raw bytes up to the newline instead of calling `read_line`, so the whole bad line is used up before any text check runs.
- It then converts those bytes to text. If that fails, it returns `Malformed`, the same error a line of bad JSON already gets.
- End of input still returns `Ok(None)`, and a real read failure is still `Io`.

Per the brief, I added no tests and ran only `cargo check`, not the test suite or the task gate.

Next: run `cargo test -p shep-channel` to confirm the existing `a_malformed_line_is_recoverable` test still passes.
